summary_md:
# Avsnitt 594 - Om man var lika rik som Dart

**Feed**: fill-or-kill  
**Published**: 2026-08-18  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The hosts spend most of the episode on iGaming. Kenneth Dart's mandatory bid for Evolution was set at no premium, but it gave the share a floor, and together with the large buyback and ABG's SEK 1000 price target it lifted the stock. Dart is also building stakes in Hacksaw, DraftKings and Flutter, which the hosts compare to how he played tobacco stocks as the sector shifts from growth to value. Earnings season comes up through Klarna (weak guidance, share fell about 20%, host bought the dip) and Octave, which is under index-exit pressure. On macro, they discuss rising US long-term yields, Kevin Warsh's first Jackson Hole, the AI rebound and passive index flows, with a watchful view on AI infrastructure names such as Bravida and on uranium.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 EVO — Evolution | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Co-host long; Dart's bid is a price floor, the heavy buyback absorbs sellers, ABG SEK 1000 target; iGaming seen shifting to value with strong cash flows.

#### Reasoning

Dart's bid at his highest 6-month price gives the share a floor. Buybacks soak up the remaining sellers. The share jumped 5% on ABG's buy call, which suggests few sellers are left. The thesis is that iGaming has re-rated from growth to value with strong cash flow, and a long-term shift from offline to online casino supports structural growth. Dart repeated the pattern he used in tobacco.

#### Sell Triggers

- if buyback support ends and sellers return
- if black-market/regulatory concerns re-emerge
- if Evo keeps failing to grow

> *"Jag är lång."*

---

### 🟢 ABCL — AbCellera | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Host's fill of the week and a holding; raised USD 200m at no discount from a strong cash position; Baker brothers as owners.

#### Reasoning

The host owns it and names it the week's best performer. The raise at no discount was opportunistic. The Baker brothers tend to add as companies perform, and the host is watching whether they took part in the placing.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Baker brothers reduce their stake
- if rising rates hit cash-burning biotech

> *"Min fill är såklart Apselera."*

---

### 🟢 KLAR — Klarna | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Host bought more after the ~20% drop on weak guidance; sees neobank diversification, but calls buying ahead of the report his 'kill'.

#### Reasoning

Strong report but soft guidance, blamed on the German consumer, plus CFO/CMO departures. The share fell about 20%, which the host sees as an overreaction, and he added to the position. Long-term thesis: become a neobank like Revolut (valued ~800bn vs ~60bn for Klarna). The stock is very volatile and the position looks tactical.

#### Sell Triggers

- if German consumer weakness deepens
- if the investment quarter does not pay off
- if management turnover continues

> *"Så här nere, runt 20 procent minus, har jag köpt bra mycket mer än vad jag köpte en liten bevakningspost i går."*

---

### 🔴 PSNL — Personalis | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 70%

Host sold near USD 14 after Tempus AI's conditional stock bid (~16.25); the deal closes early next year, so the money is dead until then.

#### Reasoning

The bid is paid in Tempus shares with a cap, so the value falls if Tempus drops. The deal is not expected to close until early next year. With limited upside to 16 and a long wait, the host took profit after buying around 6.

> *"Så det var dead money, så jag tänkte, jag tar de pengarna."*

---

### 🟠 BRAV — Bravida | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

New data center order; picks-and-shovels AI infrastructure is preferred if AI worries return.

#### Reasoning

The co-host notes the new data center order and suggests infrastructure and grid names as a safer AI exposure than AI companies themselves. This is a sector preference, not an explicit trade.

#### Sell Triggers

- if hyperscaler capex slows

> *"Jag såg att Bravida fick någon ny sån här datacenterorder."*

---

### 🟠 XPEV — XPeng | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Host monitoring it after poor share performance; seen as far ahead in robotics.

#### Reasoning

The host follows Twitter commentary on XPeng's robotics lead. The share has done poorly and he is watching for an entry point.

> *"Den aktien hade gått ganska dåligt, så de sitter jag fortfarande och bevakar och försöker få spaning."*
